opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowship Grants, 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career historians within five years of submitting their corrected doctoral thesis in a historical subject to a UK institution (excluding parental leave, illness or caring leave); normally resident in the UK; not in full-time permanent academic employment; not current doctoral students; current members of the Royal Historical Society. Applicants who have previously received an Early Career Fellowship Grant are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £2,000 for discrete research projects lasting no more than six months, supporting career-building research or activities post-PhD to produce a discrete outcome (e.g. an article or book proposal).

opportunities.title: Martin Lynn Scholarship in African History, 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Royal Historical Society currently studying for a PhD in African history. Research must be clearly and predominantly historical in orientation with a specific chronological remit. Those previously awarded the Martin Lynn Scholarship are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: An annual award of £1,500 to support the doctoral research of a postgraduate researcher in African history.

opportunities.title: Open Research Support Grants, 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Historians who are current members of the Royal Historical Society and are not postgraduate students or early career researchers (within 5 years of completing a PhD). Research must be clearly and predominantly historical with a specific chronological remit. Those previously awarded an Open Research Support Grant are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Awards of £500 or £1,000 to support historians without access to research funding to visit archives, historical sites, conduct interviews, and attend academic conferences.
